title: STET
qualification: Only a Diploma/Degree course in Teacher Education recognized by the National Council for Teacher Education (NCTE) will be considered. || For Diploma in Education (Special Education) and B.Ed. title: Graduate Apprentice, Diploma Apprentice, ITI Apprentice
salary: Selected apprentices will receive a monthly stipend based on their category. Graduate apprentices will receive ₹15,000 per month, Diploma apprentices ₹12,000 per month, and ITI apprentices ₹9,600 per month during the first year of training and ₹10,560 per month during the second year, applicable to National or State Trade Certificate holders whose prior training period is accounted for in determining the stipend rate.
